# ChindoSpeak

> ChindoSpeak turns short-form videos into Mandarin and Indonesian flashcards. Paste a TikTok, Instagram reel, or YouTube short; the app transcribes it, extracts the five most useful phrases, and drills them with spaced repetition. It is built for Chinese-Indonesian ("Chindo") heritage speakers who already half-understand the language and need to bridge the gap from understanding to speaking.

## Product

- Platform: iOS (iPhone). Available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chindospeak-mandarin-indo/id6770179868
- Languages taught: Mandarin Chinese and Indonesian.
- Audience: heritage speakers, not absolute beginners. Vocabulary, pacing, and example sentences assume prior exposure to the language.
- Pricing: ChindoSpeak Pro is $9.99/month or $79.99/year, with a 3-day free trial. Billing is handled by Apple and auto-renews until cancelled in iPhone settings.

## How it works

- Video import: accepts Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts links. OpenAI Whisper transcribes the audio and GPT-4o-mini cleans the transcript and selects the five most useful vocabulary items. Roughly 40 seconds per video.
- Three independent skill tracks: reading, listening, and speaking are each graded separately, and spaced repetition runs on each track on its own, so a word must be actively used rather than merely recognized.
- Drive mode: hands-free review with audio prompts and spoken answers. Grading uses Apple's on-device speech recognition; microphone audio never leaves the phone.
- Offline: reviewing existing flashcards works offline. Importing videos, translating new text, and generating voice audio require an internet connection.

## How it differs from other apps

Duolingo and similar apps teach a new language from scratch. ChindoSpeak is for finishing a language you already partly know, and it sources its material from content the learner already watches rather than from a fixed curriculum.
